title: "Assorted Aliens"
description: "Assorted Aliens" is what Nilo Rodis-Jamero called this group of large-snouts (front and back). Should that be "Sordid Aliens?" Hundreds were designed for RETURN OF THE JEDI. If many of his creatures seem a bit militaristic, it may be because Rodis-Jamero's job prior to joining Industrial Light & Magic was designing heavy industrial vehicles—and military tanks!
